courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 溫哥華加拿大線
related.transfer: 可遷移「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」與「班距與有效運能」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；溫哥華加拿大線的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Bridge deflection and span sensitivity" and "Headway and usable capacity" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Vancouver Canada Line must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦新建自動捷運橋隧轉換與系統驗收；溫哥華加拿大線則以機場都市分支捷運合流與車站容量為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on new automated metro bridge tunnel transitions and assurance; Vancouver Canada Line centres on airport urban branched metro merging and station capacity, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」與「快慢車追及與待避」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到溫哥華加拿大線，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「周轉時間與車隊需求」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity” and “Fast-slow train catch-up”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Vancouver Canada Line, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Round-trip time and fleet size", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 雪梨地鐵西北線
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2019 年：雪梨地鐵西北線於五月開始旅客服務；2024 年：雪梨地鐵網路向市中心延伸投入服務。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以雪梨地鐵西北線為背景，建立高架、地下與轉乘站交替的自動運轉教學路線。學徒從結構變形追蹤到定位和車門介面，並以不同試驗證據檢查全線服務是否具備可追溯的驗收條件與復原能力。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2019: Sydney Metro Northwest began passenger service in May; 2024: The Sydney Metro network extension toward the city centre entered service. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Sydney Metro Northwest as the setting for an automated-operation teaching route alternating elevated, underground and interchange sections. Trace structural movement through localisation and door interfaces. Use different test evidence to check whether the complete service has traceable acceptance conditions and recovery capability, instead of treating successful operation of one train as proof of full-system readiness. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.
